answer: An agent economy can require every account to lock a fixed deposit before it may vote on reputation or claim scarce work, then slash that deposit when independent audits show it fabricated transactions. Creating a thousand identities no longer gives free influence: each must tie up real capital, and detected fraud destroys the stake. Honest agents can use an ember or nectar badge as a harmless label, or wander between tasks, but labels and movement do not bypass the deposit or restore slashed funds.
